Description.description: Outbox for PP-15 notification events. A row is written in the same transaction as the state change that caused it and drained separately by server-side email (AD-035, OD-030), which is what makes retries safe and duplicate sends impossible.
Body of the email to send.
Plug-in execution correlation id, so a notification can be tied to the command that raised it (NFR-OBS-01).
Which business event this notifies. The five AD-035 names, plus Case passed for the adviser letter added 2026-09-10; PP-15's other names are not enumerated in any requirement (OD-030 gap (a)).
A case was allocated to a checker (BR-003, AD-040/AD-076).
A checker submitted a review (FR-017).
A remediation action was raised against an adviser (BR-006, FR-020).
A T&C Manager approved a remediation (BR-008, FR-023).
A T&C Manager rejected a remediation and sent it back (BR-008).
A submit closed the case having raised no remediation, so the adviser is told it passed (project owner, 2026-09-10).
Which business event this notifies. The five AD-035 names, plus Case passed for the adviser letter added 2026-09-10; PP-15's other names are not enumerated in any requirement (OD-030 gap (a)).
Why the send failed. Set only on Failed, so a stuck outbox says why rather than going quiet.
Human-readable label for the notification.
Deterministic per event and target, and the alternate key: a retry of the same state change collides here instead of queueing a second email.
Unique identifier for entity instances
When the row was written, which is when the state change committed.
Work email of the person to notify (AD-010, the canonical cross-system identifier).
When the send succeeded. Empty while Pending or Failed.
Where the row is in the outbox: Pending, Sent or Failed.
Written and waiting to be drained. The safe resting state.
Handed to Dataverse server-side email successfully.
The send failed; al_failurereason says why and the row can be retried.
Where the row is in the outbox: Pending, Sent or Failed.
Subject line of the email to send.
Id of the record the event happened to.
Logical name of the record the event happened to. A string pair rather than a lookup, matching al_auditevent, so the outbox does not constrain what it can point at.
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.
Date and time when the record was created.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.
Sequence number of the import that created this record.
Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.
Date and time when the record was modified.
Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
Date and time that the record was migrated.
Owner Id
Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record
Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.
Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.
